name: tia_set_network_node
description: Set the Ethernet node attributes of a device interface: IP address, subnet mask, router and PROFINET device name. Setting pn_device_name turns automatic name generation off unless pn_name_auto_generation is given. Only offline project data changes; nothing is sent to a device.

device_name.description: Exact device (station) name as listed by tia_list_devices, e.g. 'PLC_1' or 'ACS480_1'.

interface_path.description: Device-item path of the network interface; omit when the device has only one Ethernet interface.

pn_name_auto_generation.description: Generate the PROFINET device name automatically.
